items_all.title: Google's WikiSkill gives AI agents a persistent memory of past mistakes to sharpen future performance
items_all.summary: Google Research has introduced WikiSkill, a framework that gives AI agents a persistent knowledge base. Instead of discarding what they learned after each run, agents document both failures and successes in a wiki-like structure and use that knowledge to get better over time. Larger models benefit more, but smaller models with WikiSkill can match the performance of larger ones without it. The article Google's WikiSkill gives AI agents a persistent memory of past mistakes to sharpen future performance appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: Google Research 推出了 WikiSkill，這是一個為 AI 智能體提供持久知識庫的框架。智能體不會在每次運行後丟棄學習到的知識，而是將成功和失敗都記錄在類似維基百科的結構中，並利用這些知識不斷改進。大型模型受益更多，但即使使用 WikiSkill，小型模型也能達到未使用該框架的大型模型的性能水平。文章《Google's WikiSkill 為 AI 智能體提供對過去錯誤的持久記憶，以提升未來表現》最初發表於 The Decoder 網站。

items_all.title: LAION drops massive open video dataset with 10 million hours of footage for AI research
items_all.summary: LAION's Big Video Dataset (BVD) is one of the largest open video datasets for AI research, with 80 million videos, 10 million hours of runtime, and 55 million auto-described clips. Models trained on BVD beat the previous benchmark, InternVid, by up to 2.1 percentage points. Legally, LAION can likely point to a 2024 Hamburg court ruling that allows collecting copyrighted content for non-commercial research. The article LAION drops massive open video dataset with 10 million hours of footage for AI research appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: LAION 的大型視訊資料集 (BVD) 是目前最大的開放視訊資料集之一，用於人工智慧研究，包含 8000 萬個影片、1000 萬小時的運行時間和 5500 萬個自動描述的片段。在 BVD 上訓練的模型比先前的基準資料集 InternVid 的效能高出 2.1 個百分點。在法律方面，LAION 可以援引 2024 年漢堡法院的一項裁決，該裁決允許出於非商業研究目的收集受版權保護的內容。本文《LAION 發布包含 1000 萬小時影片素材的大型開放視訊資料集用於人工智慧研究》最初發表於 The Decoder 網站。

items_all.title: Hugging Face Unveils Microduck: A $399 Open-Source 25 cm Biped You Train with Reinforcement Learning
items_all.summary: Pollen Robotics, the Bordeaux robotics team at Hugging Face, opened pre-orders for Microduck — a 25 cm bipedal robot where every movement is a neural policy trained in MuJoCo and exported to ONNX. At $399, it puts the full sim-to-real loop on a desk: 15 motors, camera, LiDAR, two IMUs, and an Apache-2.0 training stack you can retrain yourself. The post Hugging Face Unveils Microduck: A $399 Open-Source 25 cm Biped You Train with Reinforcement Learning appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all.summary_zh: 波爾多機器人團隊Pollen Robotics（隸屬於Hugging Face）開啟了Microduck的預售。 Microduck是一款25公分的雙足機器人，它的每個動作都基於在MuJoCo中訓練並匯出為ONNX格式的神經策略。售價399美元，它讓用戶能夠輕鬆地將完整的模擬到實戰循環搬到桌面上：15個馬達、攝影機、雷射雷達、兩個慣性測量單元（IMU）以及一個可供用戶自行重新訓練的Apache 2.0訓練棧。這篇文章《Hugging Face發布Microduck：一款售價399美元的開源25公分雙足機器人，可使用強化學習進行訓練》最初發表於MarkTechPost網站。

items_all.title: Introducing Hy4 Preview
items_all.summary: Introducing Hy4 Preview New open weight text input (no vision) LLM from Chinese company Tencent today: 770B total parameters, 49B active parameters, 1M token context window, 1.56TB on Hugging Face . This is a big size increase from their previous Hy3 in July, which was 295B, 21B active, 256,000 context, 598GB. I recently started using model chat templates to better understand their capabilities. Here's Hy4's chat_template.jinja on Hugging Face, which includes this section: {% - if not reasoning_effort is defined %} {% - set reasoning_effort = 'high' %} {% - elif reasoning_effort not in [ 'high' , 'no_think' ] %} {% - if reasoning_effort is none %} {{- raise_exception('reasoning_effort error : None, should be no_think/high') }} {% - else %} {{- raise_exception('reasoning_effort error : ' + reasoning_effort + ', should be no_think/high') }} {% - endif %} {% - endif %} So it looks like there are just two reasoning effort levels: "high" (the default) and "no_think" (reason by disabled). I tried my "Generate an SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle" prompt with the default high reasoning via OpenRouter and got this : Quoting the reasoning trace: [...] Let's maybe add a helmet? It could improve riding theme, but may obscure head. Maybe a small cycling cap or helmet? The user didn't ask; can add red helmet? Might be cute. But pelican with big beak; a helmet might obscure. Better maybe no. Maybe add sunglasses? no. Maybe add water? no. items_all_raw.summary: Introducing Hy4 Preview New open weight text input (no vision) LLM from Chinese company Tencent today: 770B total parameters, 49B active parameters, 1M token context window, 1.56TB on Hugging Face . This is a big size increase from their previous Hy3 in July, which was 295B, 21B active, 256,000 context, 598GB. I recently started using model chat templates to better understand their capabilities. Here's Hy4's chat_template.jinja on Hugging Face, which includes this section: {% - if not reasoning_effort is defined %} {% - set reasoning_effort = 'high' %} {% - elif reasoning_effort not in [ 'high' , 'no_think' ] %} {% - if reasoning_effort is none %} {{- raise_exception('reasoning_effort error : None, should be no_think/high') }} {% - else %} {{- raise_exception('reasoning_effort error : ' + reasoning_effort + ', should be no_think/high') }} {% - endif %} {% - endif %} So it looks like there are just two reasoning effort levels: "high" (the default) and "no_think" (reason by disabled). I tried my "Generate an SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle" prompt with the default high reasoning via OpenRouter and got this : Quoting the reasoning trace: [...] Let's maybe add a helmet? It could improve riding theme, but may obscure head. Maybe a small cycling cap or helmet? The user didn't ask; can add red helmet? Might be cute. But pelican with big beak; a helmet might obscure. Better maybe no. Maybe add sunglasses? no. Maybe add water? no. items_all_raw.summary: Google Research has introduced WikiSkill, a framework that gives AI agents a persistent knowledge base. Instead of discarding what they learned after each run, agents document both failures and successes in a wiki-like structure and use that knowledge to get better over time. Larger models benefit more, but smaller models with WikiSkill can match the performance of larger ones without it. The article Google's WikiSkill gives AI agents a persistent memory of past mistakes to sharpen future performance appeared first on The Decoder .

items_all_raw.title: LAION drops massive open video dataset with 10 million hours of footage for AI research
items_all_raw.summary: LAION's Big Video Dataset (BVD) is one of the largest open video datasets for AI research, with 80 million videos, 10 million hours of runtime, and 55 million auto-described clips. Models trained on BVD beat the previous benchmark, InternVid, by up to 2.1 percentage points. Legally, LAION can likely point to a 2024 Hamburg court ruling that allows collecting copyrighted content for non-commercial research. The article LAION drops massive open video dataset with 10 million hours of footage for AI research appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: LAION 的大型視訊資料集 (BVD) 是目前最大的開放視訊資料集之一，用於人工智慧研究，包含 8000 萬個影片、1000 萬小時的運行時間和 5500 萬個自動描述的片段。在 BVD 上訓練的模型比先前的基準資料集 InternVid 的效能高出 2.1 個百分點。在法律方面，LAION 可以援引 2024 年漢堡法院的一項裁決，該裁決允許出於非商業研究目的收集受版權保護的內容。本文《LAION 發布包含 1000 萬小時影片素材的大型開放視訊資料集用於人工智慧研究》最初發表於 The Decoder 網站。
